sanskrit: yaśase ca tathā saṃkhyā vāhanādyaiḥ sahasrikā | muktikāmorcayecchaṃbhuṃ paṃcakoṭyā subhaktitaḥ || jñānārthī pūjayetkoṭyā śaṃkaraṃ loka śaṃkaram | śivadarśanakāmo vai tadardhena prapūjayet || tathā mṛtyuṃjayo jāpyaḥ kāmanāphalarūpataḥ | paṃcalakṣā japā yarhi pratyakṣaṃ tu bhavecchivaḥ ||
english: 20. For achieving glory with plenty of vehicles, worship for a thousand times shall be performed. A person desiring salvation shall worship Śiva five crores of times with deep devotion. 21. A person seeking knowledge shall worship Śiva, the benefactor of the world, ten million times. A person desiring Śiva’s vision shall worship Him five million times. 22. The Mṛtyuñjaya mantra shall be repeated half a million times when Śiva shall be visible to the devotee and fulfil his desires.
